scripts.build: tsx scripts/build-content.ts && vite build && tsx scripts/copy-post-images.ts && tsx scripts/verify-dist.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name webapp
scripts.build:preview: CONTENT_MODE=preview tsx scripts/build-content.ts && OUT_DIR=dist-preview vite build && OUT_DIR=dist-preview tsx scripts/copy-post-images.ts && OUT_DIR=dist-preview tsx scripts/verify-dist.ts
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:preview && wrangler pages deploy dist-preview --project-name nohuseolye-preview --branch main
